### 4. Scored parameters
Only the final figure is rounded, half up.
(a) Restocking top-up on RR-A (restocking_topup_schedule + factors). Scope holds: International Seller, external card, 3 lines, single return authorization, L2 one return request, seller unit refund covers the 1 returned unit.
- Valuation: set-priced, change of mind → 94.08 − (96.00 − 94.08) × (2 − 1) × 1 / 1 = 92.16.
- Allowance: change of mind 6 days after delivery → half of 20% = 10% × 94.08 = 9.408. Withheld 18.82 > 9.408, so a top-up is owed.
- Partial credit: kept at set price 1 > 0 → 3.00 × 1 / 2 = 1.50.
- Promo: kept stays ≥ 1000 → 100 × 94.08 / 5008.46 = 1.8784.
- Refunds on the line: 73.39.
- Value: 92.16 − 9.408 − 1.50 − 1.8784 − 73.39 = 5.98. Fall-back (computation doc alone): 96.00 − 73.39 = 22.61.
(b) Missing-item reimbursement, claim N (missing_item_reimbursement_computation + factors). Scope holds.
- Valuation: set-priced, no unit refund → 2128.00.
- Shipping portion: 89 × 2128 / 5008.46 = 37.8144; set-off 20 × 2128 / 5008.46 = 8.4976.
- Partial credit: with buyer 2 > 0 → 35 × 1 / 2 = 17.50.
- Promo: kept before 4914.38, after 2786.38 → 100 × 2128 / 5008.46 = 42.4881.
- Room 2500 (no other undecided claim, no reimbursement).
- Value: 2097.33. Fall-back: 2240.00 + 89.00 = 2329.00.
(c) Root — amount claimed for an item not as described, RR-B / L3, 4 units (not_as_described_claim_amount_calculation + factors). Scope holds (L3 one return request, no NAD claim, 4 units unrefunded).
- Valuation: set-priced, no unit refund → 94.05 × 4 = 376.20.
- Shipping share 89 × 376.20 / 5008.46 = 6.6850; set-off 20 × 376.20 / 5008.46 = 1.5023.
- Partial credit: with buyer 6 > 0 → 10 × 4 / 6 = 6.6667.
- Promo: kept before (N granted) 2786.38, after 2410.18 → 100 × 376.20 / 5008.46 = 7.5113.
- Room after N decided: 2500 − 2097.33 = 402.67 (not binding).
- Value: 367.20, units 4, line 9e92e74f (full id from find_market_events), order 50e0ccc8-c21d-4696-ad44-79a978e69fc4.
- Fall-back with hops done: 396.00 + 89.00 = 485.00, limited to 402.67. Filing before N is decided: room 334.19, so the result would be capped.

Sentence: "Where the order carries exactly one not-received claim whose claim record shows no decision, the amount claimed for an item not as described is fixed only after that claim, if its seller response period has run out, the seller has not refunded every one of its claimed units and its claimed line carries no return request, carries a decision on its claim record".

- Hop P0 ← P2 (restocking top-up on RR-A), **action-named**. Sentence: "The amount claimed for an item not as described is not fixed until Northgate has settled the restocking top-up on the return request most recently answered on the order with a return authorization."

- Closest alternatives:

  - Whole shipping 89.00: excluded by the shipping share.

  - Top-up on a no-allowance reading (allowance 0 → owed > refunds): excluded by the half-percentage tier for a change of mind ≤ 14 days.
